concepts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create one finished, high fidelity graphic design poster for SPECTRA, a music taste map project at the KAIST graduation design exhibition. This is an actual flat poster artwork, not a photograph, not a wall mockup, not a presentation slide. Portrait A-series paper proportions, approximately 1:1.414. Render at the highest practical resolution with precise typography, intentional spacing and immaculate detail.
Input image 1 is the user's EXISTING POSTER, a brand and content reference. Develop its design substantially. Retain its pink–violet–ice-blue spectral brand, music-as-map idea, graduation context and designer credit. Do not simply copy its layout. All rendered text must be clean, correctly spelled, and restrained. Keep Korean text highly legible.
Required verbatim copy, hierarchically arranged:
"2026 ID40009 Graduation Design Studio"
"KAIST id"
"SPECTRA"
"음악으로 발견하는 나의 스펙트라"
"YOUR MUSIC TASTE MAP"
"좋아하는 음악이 나만의 지도가 됩니다."
"01 이해" / "좋아하는 음악에서 나를 이해해요."
"02 분류" / "닮은 곡을 모아 취향을 읽어요."
"03 확장" / "내 취향에서 새로운 음악으로."
"Chang Hyun Park, 20200278"
Use a crisp geometric extended sans for SPECTRA, excellent contemporary Korean typography elsewhere. Album-cover nodes should be carefully art-directed tiny miniature cover-art squares/circles without readable extra titles. No invented QR codes, no fake functional UI, no watermark, no extraneous text. Avoid random decorative clutter, illegible microtype, excessive glows and bland template layout.
DIRECTION 01 — SPECTRAL TYPE / bold typographic exhibition identity.
Near-black ink field with a thin warm-white paper margin and a slim exhibition masthead. Giant tightly kerned extra-wide SPECTRA in one dramatic horizontal line occupying the full poster width in the upper quarter, pink at left transitioning violet to cyan right. A very confident Swiss editorial grid. Korean project headline below, white, generous line-height. Secondary English caption much smaller and blue-grey.
The lower two-thirds contains ONE magnificent, enlarged music constellation: about 35 small album-art nodes grouped into three visually coherent neighborhoods, hairline cyan and violet connections, clear depth and deliberate negative space. Use fine generative orbital/topographic traces subtly around the clusters, not a giant indiscriminate background mesh. A few larger, beautifully framed album-art nodes anchor the composition. Tiny numeric indices and a few restrained ticks suggest a scientifically plotted personal atlas without fake UI.
Place the three numbered understanding/classification/expansion captions in an impeccably aligned three-column strip near the lower fifth, separate from the main art. Small designer credit in the warm-white bottom margin. Strong distance readability, black-heavy luxury exhibition poster, complete polished composition.

DIRECTION 02 — TASTE ATLAS / luminous cartographic editorial design.
A distinctly DIFFERENT layout from the reference: warm-white/off-white paper field, charcoal typography, huge sweeping cartographic music map filling the central 65% of the poster. An exquisitely designed 2D personal taste atlas, organic clustered islands of many tiny cover-art nodes, translucent pale lilac and blush topographic contours, fine cyan connections spanning neighboring islands, minimal coordinate ticks. Genre neighborhood labels, exactly "DREAM POP", "INDIE ROCK", "JAZZ", small black uppercase. At least three clusters clearly distinguish the map structure. A few stronger violet nodes mark paths of exploration. Flat sophisticated information design, not a screenshot and not a generic infographic.
Put SPECTRA in black heavy extended type upper-left, large but not across the entire page. A small gradient spectrum bar adjacent is the brand color moment. Korean project headline large at upper-left under wordmark, with the English caption aligned on a clean narrow right column. Plenty of white space, rigorous editorial margins. At the foot of the map, set the Korean sentence in a clear large one-line pull quote. Three compact numbered captions across the bottom, exhibition masthead and designer credit modestly positioned in top/bottom margins.
This should feel like a high-end museum science-art atlas poster, airy, exact, tactile printed-paper look, legible Korean, remarkably beautiful map data.

DIRECTION 03 — RESONANCE FLOW / immersive motion made visible.
A distinctly DIFFERENT, kinetic diagonal composition on deep midnight navy. One continuous sculptural ribbon of hundreds of extremely fine spectral lines sweeps in a spacious S-curve from upper-right through center-left down toward lower-right, transitioning magenta through violet into icy cyan. The ribbon is a navigable musical path, not generic background wallpaper: embed a carefully composed chain of 12 larger album-cover tiles and 35 tiny stars along it. At three bends, fine connecting constellations branch from the main path into tiny cover-art clusters, conveying understanding, clustering and discovery. Preserve quiet dark negative spaces; delicately luminous, restrained brightness, precise linework, high-end generative-art exhibition aesthetic.
Place "SPECTRA" in oversized crisp white extended type in the top third, left aligned, spanning about 85% width with the far-right letters subtly passing in front of the ribbon. Small gradient underline. Korean project headline beneath, readable and uncluttered. The main English caption lives lower-left, white at medium weight. Place "01 이해", "02 분류", "03 확장" and their short Korean supporting lines in three different quiet dark spaces alongside the three corresponding bends of the ribbon, carefully aligned with hairline leader rules, all fully readable.
Slim restrained exhibition masthead along top edge, white designer credit at bottom. No huge white QR block. The resulting poster should have dramatic visual flow and exceptional typography, clearly recognizably SPECTRA, rather than generic futuristic abstract art.
